snapshot.title: Why types beat guesswork
snapshot.metaDescription: A working note on checking claims before publishing them.
snapshot.author: Ada Example
snapshot.text: Ada Example writes on Example Notes that a typed check of a claim is more useful than a generated paragraph. She links the checklist she ran and the numbers from her own run, and she marks the rest as her opinion.
